classifier: Class-balanced logistic regression using current paired margins and rivals, de-duplicate positive identity events when fitting, no rollout labels as features. eligibility: Active recent track with four emissions and history points, published strong score >=.525, same-scan admitted alternate strong point with affinity logit >=0 and residual <=.64. These are observable proxies for target visibility.
modes: Causal automatic hold and a truth-triggered diagnostic using the same support and stable recent labels, exclude target absent at onset from oracle and positive fitting. No short-gap cohort rule, measured known absent activations invalidate promotion.
intervention: Preserve current outputs and gate; restore pre-scan physical and association state of a triggered track. Last update becomes one scan old, so consecutive holds cannot repeat on that track.
